subject: Request: temporary backstop hold & sizing confirmation for late-stage dedicated capacity
messages:
From: Julia Park <julia@helixai.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Oliver Kim <oliver.kim@helixai.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity ask — timing & temporary backstop

Evelyn — thanks again for the demo yesterday. We had a good internal sync and are ready to advance to a committed reserved cluster for model serving (late-stage POC -> production). Two asks from procurement/infra to keep the timeline intact: 

1) A short provisional hold on the dedicated pool (3–4 weeks) while we finalize the SOW and spend approvals. We need assurance the specific GPU mix (12x A100-style nodes, or a compatible quantized variant) can be reserved for our launch window (mid-August).
2) A sizing confirmation / node mapping so our infra team can align networking and secrets ahead of deployment.

We attached a quick internal runbook (ma_schedule.pdf) and a placeholder node list we think we'll need (provisional-node-map.xlsx). Can your team do a rapid inventory check and tell us if a 3-week soft hold is possible and what the fallback would be if not?

Short timeline on our side: contract routing this week, PO expected by 6/28. Appreciate anything you can do to avoid losing runway.

— Julia
Julia Park
Head of Platform Partnerships, HelixAI
julia@helixai.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachments: ma_schedule.pdf (6KB stub), provisional-node-map.xlsx (9KB stub)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Park <julia@helixai.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2029 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity ask — timing & temporary backstop

Julia — can do. Looping in Rishi and Ben to confirm inventory and coordinate a soft hold. Quick notes from my side:

- We can provision a temporary hold mechanism (internal ticket-based reservation) for up to 21 days for late-stage deals, subject to footprint and other active holds. The hold is non-binding and meant to protect launch runway while contracts finalize.
- I need the exact preferred SKU/quantization tolerance (e.g., FP16 vs 4-bit) to validate the compatible fallback models. If you aren't locked in, tell us the acceptable model variants and latency SLOs.

Rishi/Ben — Julia's timeline: PO by 2029-06-28, launch window mid-August. They request a 3–4 week provisional hold for ~12 nodes. Please response with inventory delta, any competing holds in the same window, and recommended fallback (lower memory quantized variant or smaller node count + autoscaling ramp).

Evelyn Hart
Director, Sales Engineering — Redwood Inference
Evelyn_Hart@redwood.ai

On Tue, Jun 18, 2029 at 09:12 AM Julia Park <julia@helixai.com> wrote:
> Evelyn — thanks again for the demo yesterday. ...

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2029 12:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity ask — timing & temporary backstop

Eve/Ben — inventory check completed. Summary: 

- Available pool in target US cluster (us-west-2 / dedicated-pool-7): 18 usable A100-equivalent nodes today. Not all are clean (some have pending soft-holds and one maintenance window on 7/3 that affects 2 nodes).
- After honoring existing holds through 7/10, free count for mid-August looks like 14 nodes projected unless additional commitments come in.

Recommendation / proposed plan: 
1) Place a 21-day provisional hold for 12 nodes (soft hold policy) tied to deal HLX-9842. This would remove nodes from open allocation but remains revocable if we escalate capacity elsewhere; notify ops and finance when the hold is activated.
2) Define a fallback profile: if we can't hold full A100s, offer a mixed cluster of 8 A100 + 8 L4-quantized compatible instances with a validated model profile (we'll run a quick perf check) — expected 8–12% latency increase but 25–30% unit-cost reduction.
3) Schedule a short verification run (1h) to validate KV cache warm-up numbers with their actual traffic profile before we finalize the SOW.

I attached a tentative node map and the maintenance calendar. If Ben can open the internal hold request (ticket OPR-6294) I'll queue the ops change and set an auto-release on 2029-07-09 if we don't receive PO.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Capacity Planning, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

Attachments: provisional-node-map.xlsx (9KB stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Park <julia@helixai.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2029 14:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity ask — timing & temporary backstop

Julia — thanks for the heads up. We will initiate the soft hold per Rishi's plan and create OPR-6294 to track. Operational notes / next steps: 

- Soft hold details: 12 nodes in us-west-2 (dedicated-pool-7), hold window 2029-06-18 through 2029-07-09 (auto-release if no PO). Finance will be notified to expect an invoice change request once PO is in.
- Please confirm which of the following you prefer ASAP: 
  * Hold full A100-equivalent nodes (preferred)
  * Hold mixed profile (8 A100 + 4 L4-quantized) — we will validate perf before SOW sign.
- I'll attach the internal change request and escalation path after creating the ticket. Julia, if you can send the final preferred SKU and the expected QPS/avg-seq length by EOD, we'll lock the hold.

Cc'ing Ops (for awareness) and Finance (for hold billing note).

Best,
Ben Carter
Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachments: OPR-6294 (ticket stub), ma_schedule.pdf (6KB stub)
